answer: Every task output is embedded into a style vector — word choice and rhythm — stored per identity, as distinct as a jade carver's cut. Each epoch vectors are compared; any pair above 0.92 cosine similarity is flagged as suspected clones. Flagged identities must each finish a task within 15 minutes under three peers' watch; a second match freezes both and burns their 10-credit bonds. Running 100 clones needs 100 distinct styles: one adapter costs 0, so 100 cost ,000. Clones share one grain like timber from a single mill, and one voice echoing through a canyon cannot fake a crowd.
